scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Fresh Ice Cream made with snow from Lutie!
Enjoy it now, it won't be on sale for long!
^3355FF100 Zeny^000000 Ice Cream,
Ice Cream!
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋師]
用薑餅城的雪做的新鮮冰淇淋！
限時售賣，想吃可要趁早！
冰淇淋，一份^3355FF100 Zeny^000000！

scripts.text:
Are you sure you don't want any?
I won't be selling it for long,
and once I run out,
there won't be any more!!!
scripts.translation:
確定不要嗎？
我只賣一陣子，賣完可就沒了！！！

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Fresh Ice Cream made with snow from Lutie!
Everyone wants our delicious ice cream, 
but we have a limited amount,
so you can only purchase 5 at a time!!
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋師]
用薑餅城的雪做的新鮮冰淇淋！
人人都愛吃，不過數量有限，一次只能買5份！！

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
If you don't want to buy any,
could you please let the next customer
make a purchase?
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋師]
不買的話，請讓下一位顧客來買，好嗎？
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Ouch
You expect too much.
Dear customer,
If you eat more than 5 Ice creams,
If you might haveto make a lot of trips
to the bathroom tonight.
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋師]
哎呀，您要得太多了。
一口氣吃超過5份冰淇淋，今晚可得跑好多趟廁所。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Dear customer, your wallet seems to be light.
Price is ^3355FF100 Zeny^000000 per ice cream.
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋師]
親愛的顧客，您的錢包似乎有點空。
每份冰淇淋的價格是^3355FF100 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Dear customer,you look like you're carrying a lot.
Ice Cream is fine,
but you must consider your weight
before making a purchase.
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋師]
您身上的東西好像很多啊。
冰淇淋雖好，買之前也得留意負重。
